scenario: [LGRA.9.6.2]: members of `Int` and `Time` resolve by the receiver's static type. Zero-argument members (`.bit_count`, `.utc`, `.hour`) have no argument list; members with arguments (`.local(tz)`, `.floor(1_h)`, `.add_months(1)`) keep theirs. Every receiver is a slot read (`r.flags`, `r.seen`), so the compiler must tell a member of the slot's value from a slot of the fact. `Bytes` has no members: its conversions left the language (LSTR.4.6). Pin: `compile_ok`.
rules_ds:
schema R scope logical:
    k: Int key
    flags: Int mutable
    seen: Time mutable

rule check:
    R r where r.flags.bit_count > 1 and r.seen.utc.hour > 8 and r.seen.local("Europe/Paris").hour < 22 and r.seen.floor(1_h) <= r.seen and r.seen.add_months(1) > r.seen
->
    log info "x"
